notes: Upstream-clone library-feature task (v4.2 family). Adds a retrying transport wrapper (httpx.RetryTransport / httpx.AsyncRetryTransport), a documented gap in httpx 0.28.1, cloned pinned and editable-installed at /app/src. The instruction fixes the public API contract and observable retry semantics but not the file, module layout or internal design. The verifier runs httpx's own relevant test modules (tests/client/test_client.py, tests/client/test_event_hooks.py, tests/test_exported_members.py), then three hidden pytest case dirs exercising retry semantics, transport-stack interaction (event hooks, auth, stream hygiene, close semantics), and a frozen snapshot check that no existing public signature changed. An agent cannot pass by writing a standalone script: the acceptance imports the feature from the installed package in fresh interpreters, so the change must live in the /app/src checkout.
